job.title: Senior Analyst, Pricing & Revenue Optimization (m/f/x)
job.email_subject: Application: Senior Analyst, Pricing & Revenue Optimization – pricing data, SQL, analysis
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your pricing team needs someone who understands both the data and the pricing logic – I have worked on pricing, promotions and product data on large e-commerce platforms for 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Pricing data management and Promotions Engine on B2B/B2C platforms
– SQL query refactoring that reduced latency; data modeling
– Business requirements analysis with stakeholders; AI-assisted analysis

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. My profile combines technical depth with close work alongside business teams, and I would bring exactly this experience to your team. Could we schedule a short call in the coming days?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan
https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191

tailoring.headline: Senior Analyst – Pricing & E-Commerce Data | SQL, Pricing Logic & Business Analysis
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional analyst with 5+ years on large e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, with hands-on depth in pricing, promotions and product data. Strong in SQL, query optimization and performance tuning, data modeling and data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Analyses business requirements with stakeholders, maps processes, writes functional specifications and translates insights into working solutions. Uses generative AI tools extensively for analysis and documentation; works in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: rebuy makes recommerce mainstream and sustainable, and pricing is at the heart of that model – every refurbished device needs the right price to sell. My experience with pricing logic, promotions, SQL and product data on large e-commerce platforms gives me a strong technical base for revenue optimization.

en.subject: Application: Senior Analyst, Pricing & Revenue Optimization
en.hook: Pricing decisions in recommerce are only as good as the data and logic behind them. I know that logic from the inside: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have worked on pricing, promotions and product data on large e-commerce platforms – writing and optimizing the SQL behind them and translating business requirements into working solutions.

bullets.label: Pricing & promotions logic
bullets.text: Implemented pricing and customer data management and developed the Promotions Engine on large B2B and B2C commerce platforms.

bullets.label: SQL & data performance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; wrote and optimized complex queries.

bullets.label: Data pipelines & consistency
bullets.text: Built and optimized data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM and engineered API migrations that improved data consistency.

bullets.label: Stakeholder-driven analysis
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners, mapped processes, wrote functional specifications and used AI tools to accelerate analysis.

en.logistics: I enjoy turning data into concrete decisions together with business teams. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, am open to relocating to Berlin or a hybrid setup and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation about rebuy's pricing challenges.
